explanation: The English article quotes one of the three signatories, Stanislav Shushkevich, speaking in 2006. He said the putschists had already broken up the union by December. They had tried in August 1991 to remove Gorbachev from power, to stop the Soviet Union turning into what he described as a confederation. The article reports that as one participant's account of why the three met, and not as a settled finding.
